method: Static nm/objdump inspection; no executing profiler or benchmark. Absolute target addresses and RIP-relative displacements normalized in independent instruction comparison, with registers, stack offsets, immediates, call symbols and local branch offsets retained.
direct_fill_findings: Runtime size load and zero-size check at 0x85046..0x85058

No added fill-library call; register allocation and move scheduling also change
limitations: Only this CartPole function inspected for fast-vs-baseline equivalence
Normalized assembly equality is not whole-binary byte identity
Extra instructions/function size do not quantify or prove the cause of a throughput delta
